purpose: Durable research/provenance sidecar for an issued Betting Edge report. The sidecar enriches history without enlarging or mutating the runner payload and records the authoritative production contract used at issuance.

compatibility.rule: Schema-2 sidecars issued before the v0.9 production cutover remain valid immutable historical evidence and are not rewritten merely to adopt schema 3.

fields.label: issued report label
fields.reportPath: exact data/history/runs path of the stored issued payload
fields.feedGeneratedAt: exact feedGeneratedAt recorded in the issued payload

reportReference.rule: slot and ts must exactly match the issued payload; the sidecar never replaces the issued payload as authority.

fields.productionContractOperational: boolean; required post-cutover and must be true
fields.productionContractPath: string; required post-cutover and currently BETTING_EDGE_CONTRACT.md
fields.productionContractBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the authoritative production contract read before handicapping
fields.runnerBlobSha: git blob SHA or null if unavailable
fields.feedBlobSha: git blob SHA of data/live-odds.json used for issuance or null if unavailable
fields.researchLibraryBlobSha: git blob SHA of canonical research-library.json
fields.r2ValidationBlobSha: git blob SHA of the active R2 manual read test
fields.governanceDraftOperational: optional historical design provenance only; must not imply draft authority after production cutover
fields.governanceDraftBlobSha: optional exact Git blob SHA of historical design draft

provenance.productionRule: Post-cutover sidecars must record productionContractVersion=0.9, productionContractOperational=true, productionContractPath=BETTING_EDGE_CONTRACT.md, and the exact productionContractBlobSha resolved before handicapping. Draft provenance is optional and non-authoritative.

recommendations.shape: array aligned to the issued recs by stable title/identity and ordinal

researchFitFields.grade: A|B|C|D|NR with optional +/- only for communication
researchFitFields.limitation: strongest caveat, conflict, era issue or research gap
researchFitFields.displayText: the concise History Fit wording placed in the issued report's existing hist field

failureBehavior.researchUnavailable: Use HISTORY LIBRARY UNAVAILABLE in the issued hist field as appropriate and do not fabricate prior IDs.
failureBehavior.sidecarSaveFailure: Deliver the already-validated issued report and surface HISTORY SAVE FAILED — REPORT VALID; do not rebuild or mutate the report solely for sidecar storage.
